area: focus and keys on the board
situation: Start at the board address #/ with the default data and let the clock run 2200 ms, so that every column has loaded.
Put focus on card SL-127 (the eighth and last card of Done) and press ArrowLeft.
question: Which card has focus now?
answer: SL-119 Fix crash on empty board, the last card of In progress (Review is empty and is skipped; the position is cut to the length of the column).

focus.name: SL-119 Fix crash on empty board
